jobs.title: Client Executive, SLED
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. About the Role We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Client Executive to join our SLED (State, Local, and Education) Sales team, managing our most strategic accounts across Texas . This is a role for a true public sector sales master—a leader who will drive Cloudflare’s most complex platform adoptions across the State’s premier university systems, major research institutions, and largest municipal and county governments. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled strategic influence, a profound understanding of localized public sector enterprise architecture, and the ability to proactively shape how Cloudflare advances modern, resilient cloud operating models for critical regional infrastructure and higher education. As a Client Executive, you will consistently demonstrate the highest level of sales mastery, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized authority on public sector IT modernization, capable of contextualizing Cloudflare’s entire security, performance, and Zero Trust product suite within the broader risk-management, data privacy, and civic continuity strategies of the State’s largest public entities. This role demands the ability to influence and engage at the highest executive levels—including County/City CIOs and CISOs, Agency Directors, University Vice Chancellors, and Chief Financial Officers —while leading highly specialized cross-functional teams to secure enterprise-wide adoptions and forge transformative digital innovation partnerships. What You'll Do Strategic Regional Revenue & Contract Leadership Architect and execute strategies to consistently exceed ambitious multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas across the territory. Pioneer contract strategies utilizing localized and education-specific purchasing vehicles (e.g., DIR, OMNIA Partners, NASPO ValuePoint , and county-specific master service agreements) to streamline procurement and maximize Cloudflare's regional footprint. Local Government & Institutional Architecture Alignment Apply mastery in understanding and influencing Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (mission/business, data, applications, technology) within highly complex, decentralized public environments. Map Cloudflare’s capabilities directly to localized public sector challenges—ensuring robust protection for citizen and student PII, compliance with CJIS, FERPA, and FEDRamp , and seamless defense against ransomware or DDoS disruptions targeting critical regional infrastructure and public utilities. TOLA Executive & Civic Stakeholder Engagement Lead and orchestrate multiple, simultaneous, highly complex engagements across the State’s premier public landscape, including major local governments (e.g., Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Louisiana Agencies, The largest Counties and Cities ) and higher education ecosystems (e.g., UT, Texas A&M, U of Houston, Texas State, U of N. Texas, ULS, LCTCS, OK State & U of OK . Expertly bridge the gap between centralized IT governance, decentralized municipal departments (e.g., public safety, transportation), and individual academic colleges to build consensus and drive enterprise platform sales. Precision Forecasting & Public Fiscal Cycle Mastery Operates with unmatched accuracy in forecasting, proactively shaping and managing a strategic pipeline aligned with municipal fiscal years, university funding cycles, and regional budget approval timelines. Provide insights that set the stage for Cloudflare's future localized SLED direction, influencing company-wide product and engineering priorities for the regional government and education sectors. Digital Transformation & Critical Infrastructure Protection Exhibit mastery in understanding the intricate nuances of digital transformation in the public square (e.g., securing digital citizen services, defending smart-city initiatives, protecting institutional intellectual property, and modernizing hybrid learning environments). Identify regional market shifts, regulatory compliance mandates, and public sector-specific needs to construct pioneering digital innovation partnerships between Cloudflare and TOLA’s leading institutions. Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 12+ years of unparalleled experience selling complex, transformative technology solutions (Security, Networking, Cloud) into the SLED market , with an irrefutable track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quotas within major local government and university ecosystems. Deep Texas territory expertise , with a strong, active network of existing relationships across Texas county/city IT leadership, major municipal agencies, administrators, and prominent universities across the TOLA region. Strong familiarity with public procurement protocols , including direct experience leveraging regional cooperative contracts ( OMNIA, Sourcewell ), DIR network resources, municipal RFP processes, and collaborative purchasing consortia. Mastery-level knowledge of Cloudflare's entire product suite (Zero Trust, SASE, Application Security, WAAP) and how it maps to SLED compliance frameworks, specifically CJIS, FERPA, FEDRamp, and the Higher Education Cloud Vendor Assessment Tool (HECVAT) . Proven success in engaging and influencing at the highest executive levels of regional government and academia, including County/City CIOs and CISOs, General Managers, University Vice Chancellors of IT, and Chief Financial Officers. Demonstrated capability to navigate the decentralized nature of large public entities, successfully executing enterprise agreements that satisfy both central IT leadership and independent departmental or academic stakeholders. Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills , capable of translating complex technical architectures into compelling, mission-driven outcomes for non-technical city councils, county boards of supervisors, and university trustees. Bachelor's degree required ; an advanced degree (MBA, MPA, or an advanced technical degree) is highly preferred. Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the TOLA region (primarily Texas) as required for deep strategic alignments and executive engagements. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric publi…

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Executive, SLED — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Cloudflare Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Executive, SLED opportunity with Cloudflare at Cloudflare.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist - Value & Access Strategy
jobs.description: Career Category Value and Access Job Description ABOUT AMGEN At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. ABOUT THE ROLE Role Description: As an Associate Data Scientist, you will help build next-generation AI-powered platforms that transform how commercial, contracting, and patient access strategies are designed and executed across the US Value & Access organization. Our AI portfolio includes AI copilots, intelligent contract systems, anomaly detection engines, and real-time decision platforms that directly impact how Amgen serves patients and partners. In this role, you will work on production-grade AI systems, contributing to the development of scalable, intelligent solutions that integrate structured and unstructured data, power decision-making, and deliver measurable business impact. You will collaborate with senior data scientists, engineers, and business partners to bring cutting-edge GenAI, LLM, and ML solutions from prototype to production. Roles & Responsibilities: You will contribute to one or more of the following high-impact areas: AI Copilots & Agents : Build LLM-powered assistants, implement prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and agentic workflows and related applications Intelligent Document & Contract AI: Extract, classify, and query insights from unstructured documents (contracts, policies, SOPs); build NLP pipelines for semantic search and summarization Data & AI Platforms: Work on data ingestion, transformation, and feature engineering pipelines; contribute to scalable AI/ML infrastructure Real-time AI Systems: Build APIs, dashboards, and backend services that power AI-driven insights for end users Analytics & Decision Engines: Develop anomaly detection models (e.g., claims, pricing, Gross-to-Net); build forecasting and optimization models to support commercial decisions Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to translate business needs into technical specifications, focusing on AI-driven automation and insights Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and adopt best practices across MLOps and software engineering Functional Skills: Must-Have Skills: Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL Solid understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, and System Design fundamentals Hands-on experience with core Machine Learning techniques (Regression, Classification, Clustering) Working knowledge of NLP fundamentals (tokenization, embeddings, transformers) Exposure to LLMs (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Anthropic, etc.) and prompt engineering / GenAI workflows Experience with data manipulation libraries ( Pandas, NumPy ) and working with both structured and unstructured data Familiarity with REST APIs and backend development basics Mandatory hands-on experience with 2–3 real AI/ML projects AI/GenAI: LLM-based chatbot with RAG (document Q&A), AI summarization tools, or agent-based multi-step reasoning systems Engineering: Deployed ML models (API or web app), data pipelines (ETL/ELT) Good-to-Have Skills: Experience with RAG pipelines and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate) Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agent frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI) Exposure to MLOps tools (Docker, CI/CD, MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow) Knowledge of time-series forecasting and anomaly detection techniques Frontend basics ( Streamlit, React ) for building dashboards and demos Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Experience with Databricks for data analytics and ML workflows Foundational understanding of the US pharmaceutical ecosystem, relevant datasets (e.g., claims, prescription data), and Patient Support Services offerings Professional Certifications (optional): Any AWS / Azure / GCP certification (preferred) Any Python, Machine Learning, or GenAI certification (preferred) Soft Skills: Initiative to explore new technologies and alternate approaches to solving problems Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to break down complex problems Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work effectively with global, virtual, cross-functional teams High degree of curiosity, initiative, and self-motivation Team-oriented mindset with a focus on collective goals Ability to manage multiple priorities and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment Basic Qualifications: - Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or other STEM majors - 2–6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, data science, or software engineering roles - Demonstrated portfolio of AI/ML projects (GitHub, publications, or production deployments) EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation. .

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel, Ads Product
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We’re looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy, and pragmatic attorney to join our Ads Legal team as Associate General Counsel, Ads Product. This role will provide legal guidance to our Ads Product and Engineering teams on a wide range of initiatives while collaborating with other partners across the company, including our commercial legal, ads policy, sales, privacy, and regulatory teams. This is an opportunity for an attorney who is mission-focused, proactive, and driven to make a big impact on Reddit’s rapidly growing ads business. Location : Remote – United States (NYC/SF preferred but not required) What You’ll Do: Enable Product Growth: Leverage a deep understanding of technical product operation and business strategy to advise teams building products and features in a fast-paced, high-growth setting. Work Autonomously: Serve as principal legal advisor to various ads product areas, and develop subject-matter expertise to lead cross-product initiatives. Guide Strategy: Develop principles and frameworks that will help teams design products for a changing regulatory environment. Counsel Emerging Technologies: Advise on cutting-edge technology, including AI-driven features, data-clean-room solutions, and advanced machine learning. Engage Across Functions: Work closely with product managers, engineers, business partners, and other functions and all levels of the company. Data & Privacy Governance: Ensure that products and features comply with evolving global privacy and data laws (GDPR, ePrivacy, U.S. State Laws) and internal policies. What We’re Looking For: Advertising Expertise: 10+ years of legal experience with a significant focus on online advertising. You understand the digital ads business and the information systems and data flows that support it. Experience as ads product counsel at a UGC platform is a plus. Good Team Member: A nimble, creative thinker with lots of positive energy, superior organizational skills, a growth mindset, strong attention to detail, a sense of humor, and a team-first attitude. cold_email.body:
Dear Cognition Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Recruiter - Europe opportunity with Cognition at Cognition.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Postmarket Quality Manager
jobs.description: About this opportunity: Freenome is approaching FDA approval and commercial launch of SimpleScreen™, our cfDNA-based colorectal cancer detection test. As we cross that milestone, we need a dedicated owner for the postmarket quality infrastructure that commercial launch demands — someone who can build and run a complaint handling program that works across two distinct regulatory environments. This role also owns the CAPA program — ensuring that complaints and quality events drive real corrective action, not just documentation. You will serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents, and you will be the Quality interface with our commercial partners to ensure customer and partner feedback is captured, evaluated, and acted on. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence and a mentorship mandate. The role reports directly to the Senior Director, Quality Assurance and is an onsite role based in our Brisbane, California headquarters. What you’ll do: Own the end-to-end complaint handling process — from intake and triage through technical investigation, root cause analysis, disposition, and closure — applying the distinct regulatory requirements applicable to CAP/CLIA laboratory quality events and IVD postmarket complaints under 21 CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485. Own the CAPA program: ensure that complaints, non-conformances, and laboratory quality events drive rigorous corrective action with documented root cause analysis, implementation, and effectiveness verification. Maintain CAPA records in the eQMS with traceability required for CAP/CLIA compliance. Serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents — coaching investigation rigor, reviewing findings, and ensuring quality events at all levels feed appropriately into the CAPA program. Serve as the primary Quality liaison to commercial partners and customer-facing teams as it relates to complaints and CAPA: establish and maintain processes for capturing, routing, and evaluating partner- and customer-reported feedback and complaints, and communicate investigation status and corrective actions back to relevant stakeholders. Monitor and analyze complaint, CAPA, and non-conformance trends across all quality event streams; identify systemic issues and escalate with supporting analysis and recommended corrective actions to Quality leadership. Compile and present quality signals data: complaint volumes, CAPA quantities and their status, investigation outcomes, and trend analysis for management review and postmarket surveillance reporting. Participate in change control reviews and risk evaluations as the postmarket quality representative; provide historical complaint and CAPA data to inform risk assessments for product and process changes. Escalate issues to Quality leadership and serve as the Quality delegate in CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and FDA audit or inspection settings as appropriate. Must haves: Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical laboratory science, or a closely related field. 7+ years of quality assurance experience with direct ownership of a complaint handling or postmarket surveillance program in a regulated environment — IVD, medical device, clinical laboratory, or a combination. Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA laboratory complaint and quality event requirements and how they differ from FDA postmarket complaint obligations under 21 CFR 820/QMSR. Hands-on CAPA program experience: root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, effectiveness verification, and program-level trending. Demonstrated ability to mentor or develop junior quality staff — someone who builds capability in others rather than absorbing work themselves. Experience interfacing with external customers or commercial partners on complaint intake, communication, and resolution. Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear investigation reports, CAPA records, and trend analyses suitable for regulatory review. Proficiency with an electronic QMS (eQMS) platform for complaint records, CAPA tracking, and document control. Nice to haves: Hands-on experience with CAP LAP inspections (COM, GEN, MOL checklists) and NYSDOH Part 58 laboratory permit requirements. Experience in a molecular diagnostics, cfDNA, or NGS-based testing environment. Familiarity with MDR evaluation under 21 CFR Part 803 in the context of an LDT/IVD organization. Prior experience building or formalizing complaint intake processes between a clinical laboratory and commercial partners or health system clients. ASQ CQA or equivalent quality certification. Benefits and additional information: The US target range of our base salary for new hires is $134,425 - $170,100 . You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Please note that individual total compensation for this position will be determined at the Company’s sole discretion and may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to, location, skill level, years and depth of relevant experience, and education. We invite you to check out our career page @ freenome.com/job-openings/ for additional company information. Freenome is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity. Freenome does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Large Molecules, Antibody Design)
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in therapeutic antibodies to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in antibody design and engineering who has taken antibodies through the whole process, from target selection and lead optimization to candidate selection and IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll drive antibody programs end to end and pressure-test AI-designed antibodies against the bar a real drug candidate has to clear. This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. Key responsibilities Design and engineer therapeutic antibodies and oversee programs end to end, including target and epitope selection, choice of format (IgG, Fab, scFv, VHH, bispecific), humanization, affinity maturation, Fc engineering, and candidate selection Define the screening cascade for each program, from binding kinetics (SPR, BLI), epitope binning, and species cross-reactivity to cell-based functional assays and developability (expression, aggregation, polyreactivity, stability, viscosity, immunogenicity risk) Plan the path from lead to IND-enabling studies, including in vivo pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and the handoff to process development and manufacturing Coordinate antibody production, characterization, and in vitro and in vivo studies with external contract research organizations and academic partners Evaluate AI-designed antibodies, drive them to experimental readout, and feed results back to research teams Ensure experimental data across programs is high quality and well documented, including sequences, protocols, raw data, and failure modes Communicate findings clearly to biology, AI research, and life sciences audiences Minimum qualifications PhD in biochemistry, protein engineering, immunology, molecular biology, or a related field Demonstrated experience in therapeutic antibody discovery and engineering, including at least one antibody you helped take from discovery through candidate selection and IND-enabling studies Working knowledge of what an antibody IND requires across pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills Preferred qualifications 5+ years of therapeutic antibody experience beyond the PhD Track record of advancing more than one antibody program into IND-enabling studies or the clinic, with contributions to pre-IND or IND documents Hands-on experience with antibody expression, purification, and biophysical characterization Experience directing antibody production, assays, and in vivo studies at contract research organizations Structural biology, computational protein design, or coding skills, for example Python for sequence and assay data analysis or structure prediction and protein design tools Experience using AI or ML tools in the life sciences Publications and/or patents demonstrating scientific impact The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: ABOUT ABRIDGE Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings. Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output. Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025. We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh. The Role: We are looking for a strategic and results-oriented Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team as the operational backbone of our Partner Experience (PX) organization — Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops. In this key role, you will own the systems, workflows, and analytics that power PX — including administration of Planhat and Zendesk — while keeping the post-sale motion tightly aligned with Sales, Marketing, and Finance. As a trusted partner to leadership, you will provide actionable insights that align operations with company goals, helping to accelerate growth and optimize the partner journey — from implementation through expansion and renewal. What You'll Do: - Own the PX Tech Stack: Serve as administrator and product owner for Planhat and Zendesk — health scoring, playbooks, workflows, triggers, SLAs, routing, Salesforce integrations, and reporting. Assist with administration of our LMS/CMS platforms supporting partner education and enablement. Continuously improve these systems so PX teams maintain optimal performance. - Optimize Operational Workflows: Design, refine, QA, and implement workflows and processes that enable PX teams to operate at peak efficiency. Streamline operations to ensure seamless handoffs across the full partner lifecycle — from deal close through implementation, clinical adoption, support, and renewal. - Empower Data-Driven Insights and Strategic Decisions: Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into key metrics, including partner health, adoption and utilization, support volume and SLA attainment, and retention trends. Use data to drive actionable strategies that improve decision making and operational performance. - Enhance Revenue & Forecast Clarity: Partner with Finance to support renewal and retention forecasting, analyze commission reports, and generate revenue-related insights that align with business goals and drive clarity across the organization. - Business Partner to PX Leadership: Act as the dedicated operations partner to leaders across Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops — translating their priorities into systems, process, and reporting, and representing PX needs in cross-functional RevOps planning with Sales, Marketing, and Finance. What You'll Bring: - 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role in a SaaS company (healthcare experience is a plus). - Extensive experience with SaaS tools such as Salesforce, Planhat (or Gainsight/similar CS platform), Zendesk, and exposure to LMS/CMS administration. Administration experience with a CS platform or support platform strongly preferred. - Strong understanding of go-to-market strategies and key metrics that influence success in Sales, Marketing, and Partner Success. - Direct experience business-partnering with post-sale leadership — Customer/Partner Success, Clinical or Implementation teams, or Support — you understand how these functions operate and what they need from operations. - Fluency in post-sale metrics: net revenue retention, gross retention, adoption and utilization, NPS, CSAT, and support SLA performance. - Exceptional AI and Business Intelligence experience (Claude, OpenAI, Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, Business Intelligence tools, etc.), with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable operational plans. - Proven track record in building and maintaining commercial dashboards and reports that provide clarity and support data-driven decision-making. - Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams around shared goals, priorities, and revenue-driving strategies. - Excellent project management skills, with a history of successfully leading and driving complex initiatives to completion. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams. - A proactive, problem-solving mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational scalability. WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS: - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families. - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA. - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees. - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family. - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future. - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage. - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits. - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more. - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals. - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment. - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees. - ... and much more! EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process. STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, policy owners, and product teams who contribute to or use our measurement systems, identifying the most important problems to solve and shaping the data, dashboards, tools, and workflows we build for them. jobs.title: Performance & Talent Programs Manager
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking an experienced People Programs Manager to join our Performance & Talent Programs team. This role will own the design and end-to-end execution of some of Anthropic's performance and talent programs producing the year-round performance signal that feeds our talent intelligence layer and upholds our performance bar as we scale. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Performance & Talent Programs, and a great fit for a true builder who has both seen performance management excellence at scale and is excited to roll up their sleeves in a rapidly scaling, high-ambiguity environment. You will also work closely with our internal products team, helping guide product decisions as we build and design the architecture that supports performance. Key responsibilities Own end-to-end execution of some of Anthropic's cyclical performance and talent programs (performance pulses, promotions, review cycles, talent reviews, succession planning, etc) and the continuous feedback practices between them Ensure these programs scale durably and uphold Anthropic's performance bar and talent density as the company grows Design programs to produce useful performance signal year-round and feed it into the talent intelligence layer to inform talent planning decisions Partner cross-functionally with People Services on cycle execution, People Analytics on connecting performance data to broader people data and insights, and People Products and engineering on program tooling Act as the product partner for our internal tools team: bring the needs of managers, employees, and People Partners to the table, help decide what to build and in what order, and shape the architecture so our performance systems connect cleanly and scale Iterate on program frameworks (calibration, rating constructs, feedback formats, promotion criteria) based on data, manager feedback, and Anthropic's evolving needs Lead program redesigns and change management, including stakeholder alignment, rollout planning, and communications Develop and deliver enablement that helps managers and People Partners run each cycle confidently and consistently Minimum qualifications Systems thinker who treats programs as performance drivers, caring as much about data quality and downstream usefulness as about cycles landing on time Demonstrated experience shaping performance tooling (Workday, Lattice, CultureAmp, or homegrown), including time working with an internal tools or engineering team to guide product decisions, and partnering with People Analytics, with comfort getting into the data yourself Experience building manager enablement that changes behavior, and supporting leaders through performance, promotion, and talent conversations Strong program management skills and operational rigor, with a track record of running complex multi-month cycles and keeping dozens of stakeholders in sync Exceptional communicator, particularly in writing, who thrives in ambiguity and evolving scope Preferred qualifications 7+ years of experience designing, running, and owning performance management, talent review, or promotion programs, preferably through periods of rapid headcount growth Experience helping define requirements, priorities, and system design for internal people tools, from early idea through adoption The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 — $240,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Passion for combating fraud and abuse, with a proactive and detail-oriented approach. jobs.title: Transformation Advisory Lead, Talent & Learning
jobs.description: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW AI is removing much of the repetitive work through which lawyers have always learned and is changing how they work. Firms and legal departments now have to work out how lawyers build judgment, what competence means at each level and how to bring partners along as well as associates. As Transformation Advisory Lead for Talent & Learning, you help them answer those questions. You have built and run lawyer development yourself, so customers trust you to design programs that fit how lawyers actually learn. You will be one of the first senior specialists in Harvey's Transformation Office. You will help build our talent and learning offering, bring that expertise to client engagements run by our Engagement Managers and join our Practice Directors when a customer has a specific need in talent and learning. What you learn will shape how Harvey advises the market and what we build next. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design how lawyers and legal professionals develop in an AI-native team. Build development models, by seniority and specialism, that replace apprenticeship-era learning with something deliberate that the customer can own. - Build learning that changes practice. Design curricula, workshops and programs on how to practice law with AI: fluency, judgment, verification, supervision and client conversations. - Engage leaders. Design for how a partnership and GCs make decisions, because team members follow what their leaders role model and reward. - Define what good looks like. Help customers set expectations of AI competence at each level and link them to how lawyers are reviewed and promoted. - Make it stick. Help customers measure capability before and after, reinforce new habits and renew programs as the technology changes. - Build the offering. Create the curricula, frameworks and diagnostics the Transformation Office uses to deliver talent and learning engagements, and turn each engagement into material the wider team can use. - Bring your expertise to early conversations. Join Practice Directors and account teams when a customer has a specific need in talent and learning. WHAT YOU HAVE - 10+ years of experience, including owning learning and development or professional development at a law firm or legal department, or designing and launching a lawyer training program from the ground up. Legal practice experience is a strong plus. - Deep craft in adult learning and instructional design for expert professionals, and how to build judgment and skill over time. - A deep understanding of how lawyers develop: the apprenticeship model, how judgment forms, what competence looks like at each level and how CLE/CPD and progression frameworks shape training. - A track record of changing how skilled, autonomous professionals work, including champions, reinforcement and before-and-after measurement. - Credibility with partners, firm and in-house leadership, and the judgment to design for how they each make decisions. - Evidence that you have built programs and frameworks that others ran without you. - Energy for building something new while the playbook is still being written. COMPENSATION $200,800 - $301,200 USD DEPENDING ON YOUR LOCATION, AN APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICE MAY APPLY TO YOU. YOU CAN FIND ALL OF OUR APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICES HERE https://harveyai.notion.site/Harvey-Candidate-Privacy-Notices-319ac3fcdd7a803bb807d5094f249922?pvs=74. #LI-SZ1 Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our go-to-market teams globally! We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. We are looking for creative, high-performing talent partners who are eager to take on a new challenge as we are in the early stages of building the Talent Acquisition function. cold_email.subject: Interest in Labeling and Artwork Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Labeling and Artwork Associate opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW AI is removing much of the repetitive work through which lawyers have always learned and is changing how they work. Firms and legal departments now have to work out how lawyers build judgment, what competence means at each level and how to bring partners along as well as associates. As Transformation Advisory Lead for Talent & Learning, you help them answer those questions. You have built and run lawyer development yourself, so customers trust you to design programs that fit how lawyers actually learn. You will be one of the first senior specialists in Harvey's Transformation Office. You will help build our talent and learning offering, bring that expertise to client engagements run by our Engagement Managers and join our Practice Directors when a customer has a specific need in talent and learning. What you learn will shape how Harvey advises the market and what we build next. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design how lawyers and legal professionals develop in an AI-native team. Build development models, by seniority and specialism, that replace apprenticeship-era learning with something deliberate that the customer can own. - Build learning that changes practice. Design curricula, workshops and programs on how to practice law with AI: fluency, judgment, verification, supervision and client conversations. - Engage leaders. Design for how a partnership and GCs make decisions, because team members follow what their leaders role model and reward. - Define what good looks like. Help customers set expectations of AI competence at each level and link them to how lawyers are reviewed and promoted. - Make it stick. Help customers measure capability before and after, reinforce new habits and renew programs as the technology changes. - Build the offering. Create the curricula, frameworks and diagnostics the Transformation Office uses to deliver talent and learning engagements, and turn each engagement into material the wider team can use. - Bring your expertise to early conversations. Join Practice Directors and account teams when a customer has a specific need in talent and learning. WHAT YOU HAVE - 10+ years of experience, including owning learning and development or professional development at a law firm or legal department, or designing and launching a lawyer training program from the ground up. Legal practice experience is a strong plus. - Deep craft in adult learning and instructional design for expert professionals, and how to build judgment and skill over time. - A deep understanding of how lawyers develop: the apprenticeship model, how judgment forms, what competence looks like at each level and how CLE/CPD and progression frameworks shape training. - A track record of changing how skilled, autonomous professionals work, including champions, reinforcement and before-and-after measurement. - Credibility with partners, firm and in-house leadership, and the judgment to design for how they each make decisions. - Evidence that you have built programs and frameworks that others ran without you. - Energy for building something new while the playbook is still being written. jobs.title: Associate Manager - Corporate Events Europe
jobs.description: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role This is a hands-on role for a talented events professional with a sharp eye for detail, project management experience, and wants to grow within a fast-moving team. The successful candidate must be able to focus on event execution, be an operational contributor for all day-to-day processes, help manage budgets, support execution of tactics, activities, and other details. Must be a team player working collaboratively with sales, marketing, and cross-functional teams.
